title: Chillin' in Another World With Level 2 Super Cheat Powers Anime Gets 2nd Season
content:
The staff for the television anime of Miya Kinojo 's Chillin' in Another World With Level 2 Super Cheat Powers ( Lv2 kara Cheat datta Moto Yūsha Kōho no Mattari Isekai Life ) light novel series announced on Saturday that the series will receive a second season.

Original novel illustrator Katagiri and manga adaptation artist Akine Itomachi drew illustrations celebrating the announcement:

J-Novel Club is publishing the novel series in English, and it describes the story:

The Magical Kingdom of Klyrode summons hundreds of heroes from other worlds every year to fight in their war against the Dark One and his army of powerful demons. Banaza is one of those heroes, summoned from the Royal Capital Paluma, but something's not right—Banaza is only an average merchant. He has no magic, no fighting ability, and his stats are abysmal. Worse, a mishap leaves him unable to return home! Rejected as a hero and stranded in another world, abandoned to the far reaches of the kingdom by a cruel king who just wants him gone, Banaza's fate looks pretty bleak. But what will happen once the failed hero candidate finds himself with super cheat powers once he hits level two?

The first season starred:

• Satoshi Hino as Flio

• Rie Kugimiya as Fenrys

• Aya Yamane as Balirossa

• Mari Hino as Blossom

• Yūki Hirose as Byleri

• Nene Hieda as Belano

• Taishi Murata as The Golden-Haired Hero

• Mikako Takahashi as Tsuya

• Ayako Kawasumi as First Princess

• Yuka Iguchi as Sybe

• Yui Horie as Hiya

• Tomoaki Maeno as Gholl

• Yukari Tamura as Uliminas the hellcat

• Shizuka Itō as Damalynas

• Taiten Kusunoki as Yuigarde

• Satomi Arai as Phufun

Yoshiaki Iwasaki ( Hayate the Combat Butler , We Never Learn: BOKUBEN ) directed the first season at J.C.STAFF . Megumi Shimizu ( Banished From The Heroes' Party , My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! ) was in charge of the series scripts, and Sōta Suwa ( Combatants Will Be Dispatched! ) designed the characters. Kujira Yumemi ( Kubo Won't Let Me Be Invisible , Reign of the Seven Spellblades ) composed the music, and Pony Canyon was in charge of music production. Dialogue+ is performed the ending theme song "Utopia Gaku-Gairon" (Introduction to Utopian Studies).

The anime premiered in Japan in April 2024. Muse Asia licensed the anime for Asia, and Crunchyroll is streaming the series in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, and CIS. Crunchyroll is also streaming an English dub .

Kinojo began serializing the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Become Novelists) website in 2016, until they stopped posting on the site in November 2019. Overlap began publishing the story in edited print volumes with art by Katagiri , beginning with the first volume in December 2016. Akine Itomachi launched a manga adaptation on Overlap's Comic Gardo manga website in January 2019.
author: ANN

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Premieres First Episode to Rave Reviews
content:
Even before this year’s Anime Expo, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners ‘ highly anticipated sequel was preparing anime fans to return to Night City. Specifically, the Netflix exclusive released a new trailer along with a look at the new characters who are picking up the baton from David and Lucy following their tragic tale. Not to be outdone, this year’s major convention screened the first episode of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 , and reviews have made their way online. Shockingly enough, the upcoming sequel will reportedly be even darker than David’s story, which is hard to believe considering how brutal the original season could be.

While the premiere episode wasn’t released online, plenty of anime fans who attended the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners panel at Anime Expo confirmed that the sequel honors the series that was so beloved that it reinvigorated Cyberpunk 2077 . According to viewers, part two actually takes place during the events of 2077, though it remains unclear whether any characters from the game appear. Aside from complimenting the story, viewers who attended Anime Expo confirmed that Studio TRIGGER has once again knocked it out of the park in relation to the animation. In the first season, TRIGGER created a story with breathtaking animated moments, and it seems like the production house is planning to continue this trend for season two. You can check out some reviews from last night’s event below.

Edgerunners Will Not Bring Back David

For those wondering what will happen in Cyberpunk: Edgerunners’ sequel , one thing is assured: David Martinez will not be making a comeback. One of the saddest moments of the original anime adaptation was David sacrificing himself to help Lucy escape from the clutches of Adam Smasher. The wildly powerful cyborg has long been a terror within Night City in the CD Projekt video game, and the antagonist once again proved this fact in the anime by dispatching David from this mortal coil. Luckily, the creators have said nothing about the fate of Lucy, who was last seen making her way to the moon, meaning it is possible she has some sort of role in the sequel.

Ironically enough, David and Lucy were given the perfect ending in a venue that wasn’t the anime world. Specifically, in the recent crossover with the popular video game Wuthering Waves , players witnessed Lucy and David reunite for the first time since the latter’s demise as part of the game’s Cyberpunk: Edgerunners crossover. When Edgerunners first premiered on Netflix, it had a major impact on the video game industry, lighting a fire amongst gamers to return to Cyberpunk 2077 following its controversial release. We’ll have to see whether the sequel series has the same effect.

title: 'Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku' Announces Production Staff, Main Cast, Fall 2026 Premiere
content:
Entertainment company Hakuhodo DY Music & Pictures opened an official website for the television animee adaptation of Isle Oosaki 's Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku ( Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers ) light novel on Saturday and revealed the production staff, main cast, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime is scheduled to premiere in October 2026.

Voice actors Souhei Horikane ( Mushoku no Eiyuu ) and Ikumi Hasegawa ( Loop 7-kaime no Akuyaku Reijou wa, Moto Tekikoku de Jiyuu Kimama na Hanayome Seikatsu wo Mankitsu suru ) are starring as Makoto Takatsuki and Noa Titan, respectively.

Staff Director: Toshinori Fukushima ( Chichi wa Eiyuu, Haha wa Seirei, Musume no Watashi wa Tenseisha. ) Series Composition, Script: Touko Machida ( Maougun Saikyou no Majutsushi wa Ningen datta ) Character Design: Noriko Itou ( Undead Girl Murder Farce ) Sub-character Design: Jou Tanaka ( Somali to Mori no Kamisama ) Monster Design: Yoshihiro Nagamori ( Shangri-La Frontier ) Prop Design: Chiharu Nishimura ( 29-sai Dokushin Chuuken Boukensha no Nichijou ) Chief Animation Directors: Noriko Itou, Minoru Tanaka, Yoshihiro Nagamori CG Director: Nobuaki Kikuchi ( Mato Seihei no Slave ) Color Design: Chiho Nakamura ( Deca-Dence ), Masao Ooba ( 29-sai Dokushin Chuuken Boukensha no Nichijou ) Art Director: Yasutoshi Kawai ( Chi. Chikyuu no Undou ni Tsuite ) Director of Photography: Ayumu Kaikiri (Studio Twinkle) ( 29-sai Dokushin Chuuken Boukensha no Nichijou ) Editingy: Takahiro Adachi (Imagica EMS) ( Hikuidori: Ushuu Boro Tobi-gumi ) Sound Production: DAX Production Sound Director: Hiroto Morishita ( Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria ) Music: AstroNoteS ( Majo no Tabitabi ) Animation Production: HORNETS

Oosaki began penning the fantasy romance novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in May 2018. Overlap later acquired the series and began publishing the light novel in print under its Overlap Bunko imprint in March 2019, featuring illustrations by Tam-U. The 13th volume was released on April 20.

Shiroi launched a manga adaptation on Comic Gardo in April 2020. Overlap published the tenth volume on January 25.

J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga adaptation in English. The 12th light novel volume was released in October 2024, and the ninth manga volume went on sale in September 2025.

title: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run Stage 2 Teases New Characters (Including Anime’s Big Bad)
content:
As a part of this year’s Anime Expo, many Joestar fans’ dreams came true. Not only did JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run confirm when the second stage of the cross-country horse race would arrive, but it also confirmed that Netflix was taking a weekly approach to the anime’s comeback. Alongside a new trailer that highlights what is to come for Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli, David Production has released a fresh look at the new characters joining the race this fall. One of which just so happens to be quite villainous for his stately position.

The three new characters that the Steel Ball Run has unveiled include Mountain Tim, Hot Pants, and Funny Valentine. While showing off the designs for the new trio, JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure also confirmed the voice actors who will be bringing the characters to life. Mountain Tim will be voiced by Tomoaki Maeno ( Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War, Solo Leveling ), Funny Valentine will be voiced by Tomokazu Sugita ( Gintama, Demon Slayer ), and Hot Pants will be played by Yoko Hikasa ( Delicious in Dungeon, Shangri-La Frontier ). Ironically enough, Funny Valentine, who is the President of the United States in this anime universe, is voiced by the man who originally played Joseph Joestar in JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Battle Tendency . Needless to say, Sugita’s new part in Hirohiko Araki’s series will be far different from the original Joestar. You can see designs for the new characters, side-by-side with their voice actors, below.

Hail To The Stand Chief

Without diving into spoiler territory, Funny Valentine is certainly one of the biggest characters introduced here that anime fans should keep their eyes on in the second stage. For those who might have missed the news yesterday, the Steel Ball Run will be releasing new episodes beginning on September 25th this fall . On top of the 2026 comeback, longtime Joestar fans were thrilled to learn that “JoJo Fridays” will return, as Netflix confirmed that eleven new episodes will release weekly. This schedule will bring back the anime adaptation’s release schedule that we haven’t seen since JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind .

While the Steel Ball Run is continuing to bring us new anime episodes in the world of the Joestars, creator Hirohiko Araki is still creating new chapters of his beloved manga. Currently, the franchise is focusing on the adventures of Jodio and Dragona Joestar in JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: The JOJOLands, following the siblings in Hawaii as they attempt to financially care for their mother. It might be quite some time before we see this latest storyline animated, as once Steel Ball Run ends, the next chapter from the source material is JoJolion .

title: 'Hitoribocchi no Isekai Kouryaku' Second Season in Production
content:
Production company GREE Entertainment announced a second season for the Hitoribocchi no Isekai Kouryaku ( Loner Life in Another World ) television anime on Saturday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured).

Produced by Passione and Hayabusa Film , the first anime season adapting Shouji Goji 's isekai fantasy light novel aired in 12 episodes in Fall 2024. Sentai Filmworks licensed and streamed the anime on HIDIVE with English subtitles and a dub.

Goji began penning the fantasy adventure novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2016. Overlap acquired the novel and published the first volume under its Bunko imprint in January 2018. booota ( Hige wo Soru. Soshite Joshikousei wo Hirou. ) was in charge of the illustrations for the first two volumes, with Saku Enomaru taking over volume three onward. The 18th volume went on sale on April 20. The series has a cumulative 4.3 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

Comic Gardo magazine began serializing a manga adaptation by Bibi in January 2019. The 26th volume was released on January 25, with the 27th volume set for a July 20 release.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the light novel in English in February 2021 and Kaiten Books licensed the manga in English in March 2020. The 14th light novel volume went on sale on April 21, with the 15th volume going on sale on September 29. The 12th manga volume was digitally released in June 2025.

title: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 Reveals New Trailer, Theme Songs, Character Visuals
content:
The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 revealed its second main trailer, new character visuals, and opening and ending theme details ahead of its October 2026 release.

The opening theme, “Kono Shinzou ni Hanataba wo” (A Bouquet for This Heart), is written, composed, and arranged by 40mP and performed by Kokorone. The ending theme, “Hakuchumu” (Daydream), is also written, composed, and arranged by 40mP, with vocals by Kagura Nana. You can watch the new trailer below.

Along with the trailer, the series released new character visuals for the main cast, including Kimihiko Kimizuka, legendary detective Siesta, Nagisa Natsunagi, idol Yui Saikawa, and Charlotte Arisaka Anderson.

As part of the anime’s fifth anniversary celebration, the production also announced several commemorative projects. Voice actress Saki Miyashita (Siesta) has recorded a cover of the Season 1 opening theme “Koko de Ikiteru”, revealed with a new music video.

The franchise has also launched a seasonal visual and voice drama project, beginning with a new summer illustration of Nagisa Natsunagi, whose voice drama will premiere on the KADOKAWA Anime YouTube channel on July 5.

It was confirmed that The Detective Is Already Dead light novel Volume 14 will be released in Japan on October 23, with its cover illustration revealed.

The first season of the anime ended on September 19, 2021, after a total of 12 episodes. Manabu Kurihara directed it at studio ENGI. The main cast consists of:

• Saki Miyashita as Siesta

• Ayana Taketatsu as Nagisa Natsunagi

• Arata Nagai as Kimihiko Kimizuka

• Kanon Tako as Yui Saikawa

The Detective is Already Dead is a Japanese light novel series written by Nigozyu and illustrated by Umibozu. Media Factory started publishing the series in November 2019. The series also has 2 manga adaptation: one by Mugiko (2020-2023) and one by Poni (2021-2022).

Yen Press licensed The Detective is Already Dead light novel series in English. Crunchyroll streams the anime, describing the story: After thwarting a hijacking with beautiful, silver-haired detective Siesta, Kimihiko leads a life of globe-trotting and crime-solving—until Siesta dies. A year later, a new case will open old wounds as it threads murder, conspiracy, and his dead partner!

A key visual for the second season was previously revealed.

title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA and The 100 Girlfriends Who Really Love You Season 3 Reveal Collaboration Visual
content:
A collaboration visual of BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA and The 100 Girlfriends Who Really Love You Season 3 has been revealed. Both anime are airing this Summer 2026 season.

Also Read: Review: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Premiere Leaves You Wanting More

BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA premiered on July 2 with three episodes. NICHICALINE is in charge of the animation production with Tomomi Umezu as director. Crunchyroll and Muse Asia are streaming the anime and the latter describes it as: “Waaaaaah!!” Thrown together out of the blue to make their debut, these members each have a spark of unique talent—but they are in absolutely no shape to actually be a band. Can these girls, and their band, really survive this!? “Even when the sound stops, fight back.”

The 100 Girlfriends Who Really Love You Season 3 is set to premiere on July 5 with Bibury Animation Studios returning to animate. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime, describing the story as: Rentaro Aijo was rejected 100 times in middle school. He visits a shrine and prays for better luck in high school. The God of Love appears and promises that he’ll soon meet 100 people he’s destined to date. But there’s a catch—once destiny introduces someone to him, the two must happily love each other. If they don’t, they’ll die. What will befall Rentaro and his 100 girlfriends in high school? Source: Official X (formerly Twitter) © BanG Dream! contentBlocks.caption: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA and The 100 Girlfriends Who Really Love You Season 3 – Collaboration Visual

contentBlocks.text: Also Read: Review: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Premiere Leaves You Wanting More

BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA premiered on July 2 with three episodes. NICHICALINE is in charge of the animation production with Tomomi Umezu as director. Crunchyroll and Muse Asia are streaming the anime and the latter describes it as: “Waaaaaah!!” Thrown together out of the blue to make their debut, these members each have a spark of unique talent—but they are in absolutely no shape to actually be a band. Can these girls, and their band, really survive this!? “Even when the sound stops, fight back.”

The 100 Girlfriends Who Really Love You Season 3 is set to premiere on July 5 with Bibury Animation Studios returning to animate. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime, describing the story as: Rentaro Aijo was rejected 100 times in middle school. He visits a shrine and prays for better luck in high school. The God of Love appears and promises that he’ll soon meet 100 people he’s destined to date. But there’s a catch—once destiny introduces someone to him, the two must happily love each other. If they don’t, they’ll die. What will befall Rentaro and his 100 girlfriends in high school? Source: Official X (formerly Twitter) © BanG Dream! title: Loner Life in Another World Season 2 Officially Announced
content:
Loner Life in Another World Season 2 anime has been officially announced, with the show set to return after over two years. The first anime season aired in Fall 2024.

The announcement was accompanied by a new “Season 2 Confirmed” visual, which you can see below.

Original author Shoji Goji celebrated the sequel announcement.

“Season 2 has officially been confirmed! I’m incredibly happy that so many people watched the anime, and thanks to everyone’s support, we’re getting a second season. I’m someone who believes in leaving each job to the professionals. The illustrations belong to illustrator Saku Enomaru, the manga to artist Bibi, and the anime to Hayabusa Film and the director. I hope you’ll continue supporting Season 2 as well.”

Lead voice actor Shuichiro Umeda, who plays Haruka, also shared his excitement.

“Loner Life in Another World is getting a second season! To all the fans… we’ll get to see that loner again! Thank you so much for your support. I’m thrilled to go on another noisy adventure with Haruka, despite him supposedly being alone. After meeting the Class Rep and Angelica, I’m looking forward to seeing what Haruka tackles next. I hope you’ll enjoy watching him overcome every challenge.”

Haruka Shiraishi, the voice of Class Representative, added:

“Congratulations on Season 2! I’m so happy and grateful. This wouldn’t have been possible without everyone who worked so hard on Season 1 and all the fans who supported it. I’m excited to play the Class Rep again. Recording Season 1 with such a colorful cast was a lot of fun, and I hope to bring that same energy to Season 2.”

Saori Hayami, who voices Angelica, commented:

“Congratulations on the Season 2 announcement! I’m very happy the story will continue in anime form, and it’s all thanks to everyone who has supported the series. Angelica spent much of Season 1 expressing herself through little more than breath and subtle sounds, so I’m excited for everyone to see what comes next. Please look forward to the broadcast.”

Shoji Goji writes Loner Life in Another World , which began as a web novel on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in 2016. Overlap began publishing it in print with illustrations by Boota in 2018, while Saku Enokimaru took over for illustrations after the first 2 volumes. The original novels have reached 18 volumes, with the series surpassing 4.3 million copies in circulation (including digital editions). There is also a manga adaptation by Bibi in the Comic Gardo magazine, which Kaiten Books licensed in English. The story follows Haruka, who missed out on the power selection in his new world and ended up with leftover abilities that his classmates refused to take. However, as luck would have it, they end up relying on the underpowered MC, and he will have trouble living his loner life.

title: Light Novel 'S-Rank Boukensha de Aru Ore no Musume-tachi wa Juudo no Father-con Deshita' Gets TV Anime
content:
Production company Overlap opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Kametsu Tomobashi 's S-Rank Boukensha de Aru Ore no Musume-tachi wa Juudo no Fathercon deshita ( My Daughters, S-Rank Adventurers, Have a Severe Father Complex ) light novel on Saturday. Tsubame Nozomi drew an illustration to commemorate the announcement (pictured above).

Tomobashi began penning the fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in June 2019. The series was later removed from the platform and reposted on Kakuyomu. Overlap later acquired the series and began publishing the light novel in print under its Overlap Bunko imprint in June 2020, featuring illustrations by Tsubame Nozomi. The seventh volume went on sale in March 2025. The series has a cumulative 1.6 million copies of its volumes in circulation, including digital editions.

Nozomi began drawing a manga adaptation on the Comic Gardo platform in May 2020. Overlap published the 11th volume in November 2025, with the 12th volume scheduled to be released on July 20.

Synopsis During a quest to subdue wyverns, A-rank adventurer Kaiser Clyde witnesses an ancient dragon awaken from its slumber, fly to a nearby village, and immediately destroy it. In the aftermath, Kaiser frantically searches for survivors and finds three babies among the rubble. Feeling responsible for the deaths of the village's populace, Kaiser decides to retire and take care of the children as his daughters.

Bestowing upon them the names Elsa, Anna, and Meryl, Kaiser raises the girls with as much love and affection as he can give. As the years pass, each of his daughters' talents begins to rapidly develop in swordsmanship, management, and magic, respectively. However, despite their unique dispositions, Elsa, Anna, and Meryl all have one thing in common: their overflowing love for their father that seemingly exceeds simple familial bonds. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: 'Lv2 kara Cheat datta Motoyuusha Kouho no Mattari Isekai Life' Gets Second Season
content:
Production company Overlap announced a second season of the Lv2 kara Cheat datta Motoyuusha Kouho no Mattari Isekai Life ( Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers ) television anime on Saturday, revealing a commemorative visual (pictured) and the announcement promotional video.

Produced by J.C.Staff , the first season aired in 12 episodes in Spring 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with multiple subtitles and dubs.

The anime adapts Miya Kinojou 's fantasy romance light novel , which began on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in 2016. Overlap acquired and began publishing the novel under its light novel imprint in December that year, featuring illustrations by Katagiri . The 21st volume was released on March 25.

Akine Itomachi began serializing a manga adaptation in Comic Gardo in January 2019. Overlap shipped the 14th volume on March 25.

J-Novel Club and Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the light novel and manga in July and February 2021, respectively. The 19th light novel volume was released in November 2025, and the 12th manga volume went on sale on March 31. The latest 20th light novel is scheduled to be released on August 4, and the 14th manga volume will be released on September 8.

Synopsis The Magical Kingdom of Klyrode summons hundreds of heroes from other worlds every year to fight in their war against the Dark One and his army of powerful demons. Banaza is one of those heroes, summoned from the Royal Capital Paluma, but something’s not right—Banaza is only an average merchant. He has no magic, no fighting ability, and his stats are abysmal. Worse, a mishap leaves him unable to return home! Rejected as a hero and stranded in another world, abandoned to the far reaches of the kingdom by a cruel king who just wants him gone, Banaza’s fate looks pretty bleak. But what will happen once the failed hero candidate finds himself with super cheat powers once he hits level two? (Source: J-Novel Club)
